questions_before_times: What it's for: an anniversary, a birthday, a dinner party, a class or meal prep
The date, the meal time, and the town (for the travel area)
How many guests, and how many are children
The style: plated courses or family style
The kitchen: a working oven, how many burners, fridge space and room to work
Food the guests love, and anything they never eat (likes and dislikes only: allergies go on the secure page)
safety_stop: A fire, a gas smell, or someone hurt in the home right now
Someone has a bad allergic reaction now (trouble breathing, swelling)
license: A switch from the state's form. Cooking only in the customer's own kitchen usually needs no food permit, so the business gives its registration, or a business license where the state or city asks for one.
staff_skills: ["Private dinners priced from a plan (leads only)","Set-price dinners and brunches","Meal prep","Cooking classes and lessons","Menu tastings","Kids' lessons","Serving"]
messages_never: Allergies, diets and any health detail stay on the secure page, with their own yes. No text to the customer, the owner, the chef or the server carries them: a text says only how many special plates there are, and links to the secure page. They're deleted the day after the dinner.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
